title: Unified Asset Census and Provenance Map
brief: Create one authoritative ledger of candidate assets: source class, target pillar, target artifact type, and priority. Distinguish canonical runtime inputs from advisory/archive inputs.

units.title: Census skills, scripts, hooks, course assets, extracted modules, and reference docs using mandatory lookup order
exit_conditions: Complete inventory of all candidate assets

units.title: Separate active-runtime assets from transformed-reference assets and archival content
exit_conditions: Active vs. advisory vs. archive clearly distinguished

units.title: Tag candidates by product pillar (speed/feed, post, print-to-program, ERP, build/context) and leverage potential
exit_conditions: All candidates tagged by pillar and leverage

units.title: Identify duplicates, orphans, phantoms, and stale paths; recommend consolidation or retirement
Emit conversion ledger with exact source paths, proposed artifact types, and priority rationale

exit_conditions: Ledger distinguishes canonical runtime inputs from advisory/archive inputs
Top-priority conversion work ranked by leverage and dependency
notes: Depends on PCCA-MS0A (Capability Conversion Contract Freeze). Output is the master ledger that guides all downstream PCCA work.
